# Voices: the Lanternwood Briefing campaign (invented)

A fictional stand-in for the voices layer (DESIGN.md §2.5): first-party
descriptive text about a movement, never scientific evidence. The manifest
flags this document `source_type: voices`; the structural voices filter
(#11) and the voices/evidence separation tests use it. Every person,
campaign and count below is invented.

## The campaign

The Lanternwood Briefing is a fictional citizens' campaign asking the
(equally fictional) Aurelian Assembly to hold an emergency briefing on the
basin's climate outlook. Its open letter has 48,200 invented signatures as
of the invented date 2026-07-01.

## People

- **Dr. Imara Quell** — invented atmospheric scientist; convenes the
  briefing's speaker panel.
- **Prof. Casten Rho** — invented hydrologist; speaks on the Verlan
  aquifer.
- **Sela Marrow** — invented organiser; runs the community screenings of
  the campaign's film, *The Basin at Two Degrees*.

## What you can do (fixture text)

Sign the invented letter, attend an invented screening, or write to an
invented assembly member. None of these links exist; the fixture only needs
the *shape* of a call to action.
